newsitem.title: Argentina: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Feb 4 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 5 ins. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 5 ins. at passage KM 520. San lorenzo - Five vessels berthed all loading of which 1 sbmp, 1 wheat, 1 sbm, 1 gas, 1 maize. 3 Vessels in roads, 27 due at 6 terminals during the present and forthcoming week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary during next week. Pasa berth draft 24 ft. 5 ins. Fw. Rosario - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 1 awaiting orders. 4 Vessels in roads, 8 due this week and next. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not very during next week.

Villa Constitucion - One vessel berthed discharging iron ore, no vessels in roads, 1 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 ins. Fw. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - One vessel berthed discharging iron ore, 1 in roads, 5 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Emilio Mitre channel - Max. draft for vessels up to 22 m beam, 3,200 ft./fw. (high tide). Vessels over 22 m beam, 3,106 ft. fw. (high tide).

Buenos Aires - Seventeen vessels in port, 25 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud - Max. recommended draft 29 ft. Fw. Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Five vessels berthed of which 4 loading wheat, 1 passenger vessel, 6 vessels in roads. 7 Vessels due within the next week. Depth at zero at access channel 37 ft. 4 ins. Bw. Max. recommended sailing draft at high tide 40 ft. 0 ins. Bw. with special permission of the Coast Guard. Bahia Blanca - Two vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 discharging barley. 2 Vessels in roads, 19 due within the next week. Different drafts for individual berths.

BRAZIL, 4 Feb - Vitoria - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 container/general cargo loader/discharger, 1 pig-iron loader, 1 cellulose/paper loader, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 steel coils/granite loader/discharger, 1 vehicle discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - No vessels. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. 6 Vessels waiting in roads. Rio de Janeiro - Fourteen vessels berthed of which 2 general cargo/container dischargers, 1 wheat discharger, 1 bulker discharger, 1 paper discharger, 3 steel products dischargers, 1 general cargo loader, 2 sugar loaders, 2 steel products loaders, 1 general cargo/container loader.

Tecon - 3 Vessels, 31 due over the next 7 days. Santos - Fifteen vessels berthed of which 1 bulk gasoline loader, 1 full containers, 2 general cargo, 1 bulk fertiliser discharger, 1 bulk cement discharger, 2 bulk lpg dischargers, 1 bulk chemical products loader, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 bulk pellets loader, 1 sulphur discharger, 1 caustic soda discharger, 1 salt discharger, 1 general cargo/container discharger. 10 Vessels waiting in roads. 74 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Cosipa - 1 Iron ore loader, 3 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - No vessels. Sao Sebastiao -

Tebar - 3 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - No vessels, 3 waiting in roads, 7 due over the next 7 days. Paranagua - Six vessels berthed of which 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 general cargo discharger, 2 general cargo loaders. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load containers, 3 to discharge (1 pellets, 2 general cargo). 7 Vessels due over the next 17 days. Rio Grande - Five vessels berthed of which 1 cellulose discharger, 1 full container loader, 2 soya loaders, 1 wood-chip loader. 2 Vessels waiting in roads, 11 due over the next 10 days.

CHILE, Feb 3 - Arica - One vessel berthed and operating, 4 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Two vessels berthed and operating, 2 berths vacant, 10 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Two vessels berthed, 5 berths vacant, 10 vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Five vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant, 1 berth (pier 3) out of service for enlargement until April. 20 Vessels due during the week, with 1 days delay expected. San Antonio - Eight vessels in port operating, 1 berth vacant. 14 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time.

Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, 1 reefer waiting in roads, 3 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 5 due during the week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and operating, 3 vessels due this week, no vessels in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed and operating, no berths vacant, 1 vessel waiting in roads, 7 due during the week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed. Steel pier - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 due this week. Coronel pier - No vessels berthed, 1 vessel due. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, 20 due during the week. Lirquen - Four vessels berthed, 4 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels at berth.

PERU, Feb 3 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Three vessels anchored, 9 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored, 1 bulk urea vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels, no delays. Talara - Four oil tankers anchored, no vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fish meal vessel anchored, no vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Ilo - No vessels anchored, 3 fish oil vessels berthed, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Feb 3 - Puerto Cabello - Three vessels anchored, 11 berthed of which 2 grain cargo, 4 general cargo, 1 bulk cargo, 3 containers, 1 under repair. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Four vessels anchored, 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Feb 4 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river - Draft 4/2 29 ft. 5 ins. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels loading iron ore, 3 due. Venalum - One vessel loading alumium. Matanzas - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 7 operating of which 3 loading steel products, 4 loading/discharging general cargo. Palua - One passenger vessel. Boca Grande - One vessel due. Interalumina - One vessel due.

San Felix - One vessel due. La Guaira - Five vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 10 vessels due, 1 passenger vessel, 2 vessels under repairs. Puerto Cabello - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 11 operating of which 7 loading/discharging general cargo, 2 discharging grain, 1 potatoes, 1 sugar. 10 Vessels due. Guanta - One vessel discharging salt, 3 vessels due. Maracaibo - Four vessels loading/discharging general cargo. Puerto Miranda - Six vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - Two vessels loading urea. Buoy B.71 - One vessel loading coal. Palmarejo Sur - One vessel loading crude oil.

La Salina - Three vessels loading crude oil. Bajo Grande - Refined products terminal - 2 Vessels loading crude oil, gasoline, 1 vessel loading gasoline. Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, La Ceiba - No vessels. Amuay - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Cardon - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products.
